name: Rev'd Ben Banjoko
biography: Seasoned Baptist minister and theologian committed to preaching the Word of God with clarity and power, focusing on spiritual growth and transformation.

name: Rev'd Adebisi Ikotun
biography: Anointed minister of the gospel and teacher, with a specific focus on awakening leaders to the current move of God and ministerial excellence.

name: Rev'd Alade James
biography:
Alade James is a minister of the Gospel with a deep passion for counselling singles, couples, and families. He obtained his educational qualifications from Adeniran Ogunsanya College of Education, the University of Lagos, and Obafemi Awolowo University, Ile-Ife. He also received his theological training at the Nigerian Baptist Theological Seminary, Ogbomoso.

Over the years, he has served in various leadership capacities within the church, including as President of this fellowship at the local, zonal, association, conference, and national levels.

He is happily married and blessed with children. He currently serves as the Pastor of Golden Gate Baptist Church, Obadore, Lagos.

name: Rev. Victor Adeleke Kolawole
biography:
Rev. Victor Adeleke Kolawole is a Baptist-trained minister, called by God into an apostolic ministry, and graciously blessed with diverse spiritual gifts for the glory of God and the edification of the Body of Christ. He is known for his practical, life-applicable preaching of God's Word and the undeniable demonstration of the Holy Spirit's power, with enduring testimonies following his ministry. He has been a vessel in numerous crusades, revivals, conferences, and church programs across Lagos and beyond.

His leadership roots run deep: he served as Campus Coordinator of the Lagos State Baptist Student Fellowship (BSF) in 2007 and became the Pioneer President of the Lagos Central Baptist Student Fellowship in 2010. Today, he serves as the Lead Pastor of Livingstone Baptist Church, Festac Town, Lagos.

Rev. Victor is the host of the widely followed daily prayer program, LET US PRAY, a global online ministration that reaches listeners in several nations, accompanied by remarkable miracles and testimonies. He is also a published author of the impactful books: One More Push, Success Code, and The 7th Time.

Academically, he holds a Bachelor of Education from Ekiti State University, having earlier studied Political Science/Social Studies at Adeniran Ogunsanya College of Education. He earned a Master of Divinity in Missions from the prestigious Nigerian Baptist Theological Seminary, Ogbomoso, and a Master's in Counselling Psychology from Lagos State University, Ojo.

He is happily married to his beloved wife, Pastor Olatundun Modupe, and together they are blessed with wonderful children.

name: Rev'd Dr. Julius Oluwole
biography: Anointed servant of God and teacher of the Word, ministering at Refreshing 2026.

name: Rev'd Dr. Olafimihan Enoch Abimbola
biography:
Rev. Dr. Olafimihan Enoch Abimbola is a seasoned Baptist minister, teacher, and servant of God with a passion for spiritual growth, discipleship, and kingdom advancement. He is the Moderator of Abundant Life Baptist Association (ALBA), Lagos East Baptist Conference, and the Pastor of Glory Baptist Church, Ilupeju Ijede, Ikorodu, Lagos State.

He is committed to preaching the Word of God, mentoring young people, and equipping believers to live purposeful Christian lives. Through his ministry, he has served in various leadership capacities and contributed to the growth and development of the Baptist family.

Rev. Dr. Abimbola is married to Mrs. Folashade Grace Abimbola, and they are blessed with children. His passion is to raise a generation of believers who will advance God's Kingdom and impact their communities positively.
affiliation: Moderator, ALBA & Pastor, Glory Baptist Church

name: Prof. Yinka Aladesida
biography: Distinguished academician and Kingdom influencer, co-facilitating the Academic Seminar at Refreshing 2026.

name: Dr. Mary Olatorera Olayanju
biography:
To the glory of God, Dr. Mary Olatorera Olayanju (Nee Akinrinola) is a seasoned Senior lecturer and Researcher at the Federal College of Education (Technical), Akoka, Lagos. She was recently appointed to Head the Department of Health Education in the same institution. She is also currently a Researcher at the Mutegi STEM Lab, Old Dominion University, Virginia, Norfolk, USA.

She is a member of many distinguished professional bodies like the National Association of Research in Science Teaching, USA. In 2024, she won the FEF Post-doctoral award for the overall best PhD thesis in Nigeria. Thereafter, based on her outstanding contributions to Academia, she was conferred the award of Fellow, Institute of Policy Management and Leadership Development, Nigeria.

She holds a BSc. Ed in Integrated Science, M.Ed. in Science Education and Ph.D. in Science Education. By the grace of God, got born again on July 5, 1993.

She has been privileged to serve the Lord in different capacities in the Church at large, Youth fellowship, Lydia and BSF; these include: LSBSF Female Campus Coordinator (2002-2003), LSBSF Vice President (2003-2005).

She's presently serving among women and young professionals forum; and serving as a Missionary with her husband in the Deeper life Bible Church, Ogun State. She is happily married to Pastor Taiwo Olayanju and they are blessed with amazing jewels.
affiliation: HOD Health Education, FCE(T) Akoka; Researcher, Mutegi STEM Lab, ODU USA

name: Min. Rebecca Olowookere
biography:
Rebecca Olowookere Iyanuoluwa is a devoted child of God, called and anointed to bring healing and deliverance to men across every season of life. Through her God-given gifts of ministry, she carries a mandate to restore hope, bring spiritual freedom, and point hearts back to the presence of God through worship.

Beyond ministry, Rebecca is a dedicated student and a Kingdom Entrepreneur. She integrates her faith with purpose-driven enterprise, believing that business can be a vessel for impact, excellence, and the advancement of God's Kingdom on earth.

Her life's pursuit is simple yet profound: to raise a generation that is hungry for God, rooted in worship, Word, prayers and committed to living out His purpose in every sphere of influence.

name: Rev'd. Ebenezer Osundele
biography: Anointed minister of God delivering the Refreshing Night keynote message at Refreshing 2026.

name: Mrs. Victoria Olaogun
biography:
Victoria Olayemi Olaogun is a Registered Nurse with over 27 years of clinical experience across hospital and industrial settings. A devoted Christian, she is a skilled public speaker on both spiritual and secular platforms.

Victoria serves as a counsellor, mentor, and teacher. She is the convener of the Single Ladies Forum, an initiative dedicated to equipping young women to become responsible and effective mothers and wives. Her teaching spans health, spiritual growth, and marriage.

She currently works as a Health and Wellness Specialist at a multinational company.

Victoria is married to Oluwafemi, a pastor, and their marriage is blessed with both biological and spiritual children.
affiliation: Health & Wellness Specialist; Convener, Single Ladies Forum

name: Rev'd. Tunde Babatunde
biography:
Rev'd Tunde Babatunde is a retired, Baptist trained Pastor. Before his ordination into full time ministry, he had ministered as evangelist and teacher of the word of life in many Baptist churches and some other denominations. His ministries extend to fellowships in higher institutions. He has served as President of BSF, Yaba College of Technology Lagos, President of The Christian Union Polytechnic Ibadan, and President of Lagos State Baptist Student Fellowship respectfully.

His ministry focus is teaching the word with clarity, helping believers to grow strong in faith, encouraging a vibrant prayer life and equipping believers to walk in God's purpose.
affiliation: Retired Baptist Pastor; Former LSBSF President

name: EBUNOLAMISINGS
biography:
EBUNOLAMISINGS is a spirit-filled minister of God called to release the sound of heaven and lead God's people into His glorious presence. With a heart deeply rooted in prayer and intimacy with the Holy Spirit, EBUNOLAMISINGS views music not as a performance, but as a sacred altar of worship and a powerful tool for deliverance.

From an early age, a profound passion for the gospel and a divine sensitivity to the moves of the Spirit shaped EBUNOLAMISINGS's ministry. This calling is defined by a commitment to pure, scripturally grounded worship that points hearts directly to Jesus Christ. Through anointed vocals and spirit-led songwriting, EBUNOLAMISINGS creates an atmosphere where chains are broken, hearts are healed, and the presence of God is tangibly felt.

name: Oladosu Twins
biography:
Oladosu Esther Taiwo and Oladosu Rachael Kehinde, popularly known as (OLADOSU TWINS )are dynamic gospel music ministers hails from Okuku, Osun State, Nigeria. they were born into the family of Late Elder Gabriel and Mrs Victoria Oladosu. Born on October 4th, they are also the last-born of the family.

Their educational journey began at CAC Nursery/Primary School in Kainji, Niger State. They later pursued higher education at Kwara State University, Malete (KWASU), where Taiwo earned a degree in Mass Communication and Kehinde obtained a degree in Public Health Science.

Their passion for music started at a tender age when they joined the children's choir. Over the years, they have nurtured their gift, growing into seasoned worshippers known for their profound and spirit-filled ministrations. To the glory of God, The Oladosu Twins have released powerful singles, EYIN OBA,MIMO and EYIN NI and also they were featured in powerful sounds likes of ORUN SI BY BBO and MOMORE BY ADEYINKA ALASEYORI which have blessed lives across various platforms.

In addition to their music ministry, they are the visionaries behind Altar of Praise, a worship gathering devoted to creating an atmosphere of divine encounters through heartfelt praise and worship.

Their unique style of worship, deeply rooted in eulogizing God and leading people into His presence, has earned them the opportunity to minister alongside renowned gospel ministers such as Mama Bola Are, Tope Alabi, Bidemi Olaoba,Adeyinka Chigozie Wisdom and Titilayo Euba, among others.

With a deep sense of gratitude, The Oladosu Twins continue to give all glory to God for their journey past, present and the greater heights ahead. They remain committed to using their voices to inspire, uplift and draw souls closer to God.
affiliation: Gospel Music Ministers; Visionaries, Altar of Praise

name: Mr. Sunday Oguntola
biography:
Bro Sunday Oguntola is a child of God passionate about expanding the Kingdom of Light.

A practising journalist, he is the author of 10 Commandments for Academic Excellence and Effective media relations for pastors and churches.

He is the President of the Lagos State Baptist Student Alumni Fellowship (LSBSFAA) where he mentors the next generation of student leaders.

He is married with kids.

name: Pst. Mrs. Adebusola Oguntola
biography:
Adebusola Oguntola studied Estate Management at the University of Lagos. She also bagged a Masters degree in Facilities Management from the same institution. She yielded to the call of God upon her life and proceeded to Baptist College of Theology, Lagos where she received ministerial training and thereafter bagged Bachelor's degree in Christian Religious Education.

She is the Head of Practice at Busola Oguntola Consulting, a real estate firm with passion for facility and property management, valuation of property and assets, project development and other real estate consultancy services.

She has been involved in Christian leadership since her undergraduate days. Since she gave her life to Christ in 1992, she has remained committed to the Kingdom business. She is mandated to help in raising godly homes. She is also committed to children and youth development through godly strategies.

She lives in Lagos with her husband, Sunday Oguntola and their three children.
affiliation: Head of Practice, Busola Oguntola Consulting
